title: Charge Scale for Credits Remaining After a Reduction - Chapter 30, Chapter 35 and Chapter 1606
content:
Under Education Benefits (GI Bill and Dependents' Education), when entitlement is restored after a school reports a reduction of a Chapter 30, Chapter 35 or Chapter 1606 term, the credits remaining — the credit hours left on the latest reduction reported on the benefit — are charged on a daily scale measured against the restored term's full-time measure, with nothing charged when no credits remain.

**Scale.**
- No credits remain: nothing a day.
- More than none and less than half of the full-time measure: 0.25 a day.
- At least half and less than three quarters of the measure: 0.5 a day.
- At least three quarters of the measure and less than all of it: 0.75 a day.
- At least the full-time measure: 1 a day.

**Training questions answered from the scale (hypothetical, measure of 9 credit hours: half is 4.5, three quarters is 6.75).**
- *A reduction leaves 0 credits.* Nothing a day.
- *It leaves 4 credits.* Below 4.5: 0.25 a day.
- *It leaves 5 credits.* At least 4.5 and below 6.75: 0.5 a day.
- *It leaves 6 credits.* Still below 6.75: 0.5 a day.
- *It leaves 7 credits.* At least 6.75 and below 9: 0.75 a day.
- *It leaves 9 credits.* The full measure: 1 a day.
